questions.question: Which state had a higher estimated median household income in 2022, Alabama or Washington?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_county_unemployment_median_income.xlsx', sheet_name='Unemployment Med HH Income', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'FIPS_Code'].index[0]
df.columns = df.iloc[header_idx]
data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()

al_inc = float(data.loc[data['FIPS_Code'].astype(str).str.strip() == '01000', 'Median_Household_Income_2022'].values[0])
wa_inc = float(data.loc[data['FIPS_Code'].astype(str).str.strip() == '53000', 'Median_Household_Income_2022'].values[0])
result = 'Washington' if wa_inc > al_inc else 'Alabama'

questions.question: Between 2019 and 2023, in which year was the nationwide annual average unemployment rate the highest?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_county_unemployment_median_income.xlsx', sheet_name='Unemployment Med HH Income', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'FIPS_Code'].index[0]
df.columns = df.iloc[header_idx]
us_row = df[df['FIPS_Code'].astype(str).str.strip() == '00000'].iloc[0]

rates = {str(yr): float(us_row[f'Unemployment_rate_{yr}']) for yr in range(2019, 2024)}
result = max(rates, key=rates.get)

questions.question: How many counties or county equivalents are categorized as metropolitan areas according to the 2023 urban-rural classification?

df = pd.read_excel('ers_county_unemployment_median_income.xlsx', sheet_name='Unemployment Med HH Income', header=None)
